text:
jordan: Hey @people-ops — our adoption was finalized yesterday! Can I add the child to benefits right away or is there a different process for post-placement adoption?

lina - People Ops: Congrats Jordan!! :tada: Yes this is a QLE. For adoptions we allow enrollment within 60 days of placement/finalization depending on the carrier. You'll need either the placement letter (for placement) or final decree (for finalization). Which one do you have?

jordan: We have the placement letter from the agency dated 2026-05-02 and final decree today 2026-05-20. I can upload both.

lina - People Ops: Perfect. Upload to the Life Event Enrollment form on the benefits portal or email benefits@redwood.com with subject "QLE - adoption - [Jordan Lastname]". Carrier effective date is typically the placement date if you enroll within the window — so we can set effective date to 2026-05-02.

jordan: Great. Quick Qs: 1) Can I add the kid to the Dependent Care FSA midyear? 2) Any wait for dental/vision? 3) Do I need to provide SSN right away?

kevin - Benefits Admin: 1) DCFSA rules vary — usually you can enroll or change elections for dependent care if it's a QLE for the dependent. Some plan admins require documentation of eligibility (placement letter). You can elect a prorated contribution for the remainder of the plan year. 2) Dental/vision follow the same enrollment action and effective date, no additional wait. 3) SSN: carriers ask for SSN for enrollment but we accept "pending" initially; provide SSN/ITIN within 60 days to avoid claim issues.

jordan: If I elect DCFSA now, when do contributions start? Can payroll adjust prior periods retroactively?

dylan - Payroll: If effective date is placement 2026-05-02 and you enroll within the carrier window, deductions start from the effective date. We can retro-adjust premiums and FSA deductions back to that date if paperwork + proof arrive within the 60-day QLE window. Any retro amounts will be reconciled in the next payroll cycle and we'll post an itemized adjustment.

jordan: Thank you. Also clinician note — will HSA contributions change if I add the child to family coverage? I currently have individual HDHP + HSA.

lina - People Ops: If you switch to family HDHP the HSA contribution limits increase. You'll need to update your coverage election to family plan during the QLE enrollment; payroll will adjust pre-tax deductions accordingly. We can help calculate prorated HSA limits for the year.

jordan: Uploaded placement letter + final decree to the portal. Marked effective date 2026-05-02 and requested DCFSA + family HDHP.

hr-bot: Submission received. Case ID: QLE-20260520-773. People Ops will review within 2 business days.

lina - People Ops: I see the case. Please add the child's full name and DOB in a secure portal note (do NOT post SSN in channel). Once we verify docs we'll create the dependent and enroll across plans. Kevin/Dylan — flag for carrier special handling and FSA admin.

kevin - Benefits Admin: Flagged. Carrier may request final decree copy; we already have it. We'll start enrollment and confirm dependent IDs with the carrier.

dylan - Payroll: I'll prepare payroll changes for premiums, HSA, and DCFSA prorations. Expect a follow-up here with estimated deductions by end of week.

jordan: Thanks everyone, appreciate the help and fast responses! :smile:
